governance.note: Reserve-stack levers, all published/measured: multi-product AS co-opt on the measured ASPLANNP433 requirements; published pre-reform ECRS deployment design (no price-based release 2023-06-10..2024-07-31 per IMM 2023 SOM / NPRR1224 rejection); the lumped ORDC total-reserve family (RTORPA, NPRR568/OBDRR048 - published curve, default flat-sigma fallback documented, NP6-576-ER re-fetch egress-blocked); measured NP3-911 Load-Resource RRS-UFR credit; measured F923 coal pricing, CAMPD outage overlay, measured GTC limits, measured CHP export floors. Storage: measured battery AS power reservation, consistent netting + product credit (as ercot31) + measured HH monthly gas shape. Plus the MEASURED RTOLCAP/RTOFFCAP reserve-supply cap (G1): cleared reserve bounded by the measured online-responsive capability, so the lumped total family prices the MEASURED reserve level on the published ORDC curve, and its balance dual is added post-solve as the additive RTORPA - ERCOT's actual pre-RTC+B price formation (RTSPP = SCED energy + ORDC(online reserves); product duals are MCPCs, never added to the energy price). The measured RTORDPA overlay (deployments) and the DAM-AS overlay (2024+ DA-priced acute days the RT-scored co-opt cannot form: ex-overlay 2024 tail 10/53) remain, per-column persisted for the one-event-one-channel audit. Remaining C3 misses are MODEL MISS with named root causes: 2023 Aug -62 (flat ORDC sigma fallback vs the blocked NP6-576-ER seasonal params; sub-2-day forced outages outside the >=2-day CAMPD detector), 2024 Jan/May over (the DAM-AS overlay's DA-boundary premium vs the RT benchmark: overlay hours realized DA ~$599/$511 vs RT ~$205/$316), Feb/Mar-2025 (+5/+6 exposed by truthful gas, open thread). No adder/haircut tuned to any residual. CORRECTION (2026-07-04 DOF-ledger audit, S5): the original note's "none fitted" claim was too broad — it held for the reserve/AS stack this run added, but the run INHERITS the ercot26 fitted offer surface: 72 offer_curve_by_group scalars, the coal PRB/lignite sigmoids (8 scalars), wefor_residual=0.06 + wefor_multiplier=0.7 (audit C-15), battery_dispatch_adder=$10, coal take-or-pay tranche shares, and the nudged GAS_AVAILABILITY_FACTOR — ~90 residual-identified scalars in total, itemized with root causes in free_parameters below (CLAUDE.md rule 20). "Zero fitted parameters" is NOT a true statement of this keeper; the C6 assertions stand only in their rubric sense (no adder/haircut tuned to a price residual, no output pinning — the offer-curve tuning is the rule-#1-sanctioned surface, disclosed, not hidden).

exceptions.reason: Inherited from the ercot26 keeper unchanged (this stack's reserve carve-outs are volume-neutral on the class: -8.53 vs keeper -8.55 TWh): the model under-curtails 2023 renewables by ~4.1 TWh (model 2.46 vs ISO-reported 6.96 TWh) because ERCOT's real curtailment is nodal/intra-zone (VALEXP/McCamey/138 kV) - constraints the 7-zone reduction cannot represent (CONFIRMED by the ercot26 measured-GTC probe: the zonal interfaces saturate <1% of hours) - plus the ~3.7 TWh 923-vs-930 gas-actuals basis inconsistency. The honest fix is a sub-zonal/nodal topology (separate work stream); closing it with an offer retune or renewable haircut fitted to the residual is forbidden.

2025 preliminary EIA-923 vintage (9/41 CC_REGULAR, 24/38 CT_PEAKER plants missing): no trustworthy per-class actual, family falls back to the EIA-930 aggregate; the residual is dominated by the 930-vs-preliminary-923 vintage difference. Re-score when the final 923 vintage lands. Inherited from the ercot26 keeper (-2.8% there; the -0.2pp move is the reserve carve-outs' marginal dispatch shift, inside the vintage uncertainty).

EIA-930 battery series coverage is only ~19% of 2024 hours - insufficient for a stable 12-point shape correlation. MATERIALLY IMPROVED vs the ercot26 keeper (r=-0.306 -> +0.331) by the measured battery AS power reservation (storage_as_commitment + requirement netting), which moves the modeled cycling toward the real AS-dominated pattern; the remaining gap is the intra-day AS deployment shape the energy LP does not dispatch. Accepted measured-input limitation on 19%-coverage data.
